verdict.rationale: Render can host long-running agents and background processes with retry handling built in (render-docs-5), and has workflow task SDKs (render-docs-22, render-docs-23). Its SSD-backed disks get automatic daily snapshots (render-docs-35), a coarse form of persistent state with automatic backup, but nothing shows a coding-agent sandbox that checkpoints its working state as it goes. The documented short-lived inspection instances are ephemeral rather than persistent (render-docs-32). Missing for 10: a persistent agent runtime/sandbox designed for coding agents, automatic fine-grained state checkpointing during work, restore/resume-from-checkpoint docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.
